items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Dave Payton, you heard Dave Payton. Joe Oliver used to play with him... Dave Payton was a crackerjack. In those days he was a cracker.

ctx.x: Sure. Did you? Teddy Weatherford? What? What I was saying. Wonderful piano player. I got a record by them, with Louis on the cornet.

Dave Payton, you heard Dave Payton. Joe Oliver used to play with him after Joe broke up his band. You heard of him in front of them. What the shit you said? Dave Payton and Oiskin Tate, he was director at the Vendome Theatre.
He's teaching music now. I guess he gave up playing the violin.
